description: This file contains source code for managing buildable entities within the game 'Unvanquished'. It includes functions for building, deconstructing, validating placement, handling animations, and managing game-specific logic related to structures like overminds, reactors, and spawn points. It also manages game layout loading and saving, and logs build actions.

classes.description: Component representing buildable entity state and behavior.

classes.description: Component representing the reactor structure for humans.
